title: 插件管理 · 亮色开关边界与阅读面

assertions.message: 开关保持 36×20 / 16px 行程并具备亮色边界
assertions.expression: (() => { const switches = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[role="switch"]')]; return switches.length === 2 && switches.every((control) => { const track = getComputedStyle(control); const thumb = getComputedStyle(control.firstElementChild); const trackRect = control.getBoundingClientRect(); const thumbRect = control.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect(); if (document.body.hasAttribute('data-ds-dark-theme')) return trackRect.width === 36 && trackRect.height === 20 && thumbRect.width === 16 && thumbRect.height === 16 && track.backgroundColor !== 'rgb(245, 236, 217)'; return trackRect.width === 36 && trackRect.height === 20 && thumbRect.width === 16 && thumbRect.height === 16 && track.boxShadow.includes('inset') && (control.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' ? track.backgroundColor === 'rgb(11, 109, 100)' && thumb.backgroundColor === 'rgb(248, 255, 251)' : track.backgroundColor === 'rgb(245, 236, 217)' && thumb.backgroundColor === 'rgb(255, 250, 240)'); }); })()

assertions.message: 插件行有轻纸面但暗色模式保持原样
assertions.expression: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('li[data-plugin-item], li[data-plugin-package]')]; if (rows.length !== 3) return false; const dark = document.body.hasAttribute('data-ds-dark-theme'); return rows.every((row) => { const style = getComputedStyle(row); return dark ? style.backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' : style.backgroundColor === 'rgba(250, 248, 243, 0.48)'; }); })()
